title: Schema validation test suite for board tasks
description: Produce board/tests/test_tasks.py (Python stdlib unittest, no third-party deps) asserting for every board/tasks/*.json: valid JSON; required fields present (id, title, phase, skill, status, assignee, description, artifacts, created, updated); id matches filename stem; phase ∈ {requirements, design, implementation, testing, release, maintenance}; status ∈ {todo, in_progress, done, blocked}; assignee is null or string; artifacts is list of strings; unique ids. Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s board/tests -v — must be green. Governing skill: skills/sdlc/sdlc-test/SKILL.md.
